items.name: GuildRanking
items.template: You are ranked within your guild, not guild against guild. Each play adds 1 to 100 points to today's season, which turns over at 00:00 UTC. Once a season is over, receive coins by your rank in your guild: 1st 300, 2nd-3rd 150, 4th-10th 50. Advance one day ends the season for you right away; guildmates who did not advance are still in it.
